(1) ROM: 8K/4K=2
RAM: (64K-8K)/8K=7
∴ROM需要2片，RAM需要7片
(2) 片选信号低电平有效: !CS=0
3B译码器中: A:A13, B:A14, C:A15
输出为:!Y0, !Y1, !Y2, !Y3, !Y4, !Y5, !Y6,!Y7
ROM1: CS= !(!Y0 + A12) (A12为0时,选ROM1)
ROM2: CS= !(!Y0 + !A12) (An为1时,选ROM2)
RAM1: CS= !!Y1 = Y1
RAM2: CS= !!Y2 = Y2
RAM3: CS= Y3
RAM4: CS= Y4
RAM5: CS= Y5
RAM6: CS= Y6
RAM7: CS= Y7
